artifacts.notes: The prologue and all seventy-three chapters, 197 LF-terminated lines, each chapter title standing on its own line in the form the page prints it ("Caput 7: De humilitate"). Not a facsimile and not a critical text: the source page declares itself half proofread, so a reading taken from this file is a web witness and needs a critical edition behind it before it can settle a wording.
artifacts.rights_basis: This file carries the Latin of the Rule alone. Benedict's sixth-century Latin is in the public domain everywhere; every template, banner, link, category and heading marker contributed at la.wikisource.org has been removed by the stated transformation, so nothing licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 survives in these bytes. A faithful transcription of a public-domain text originates no separate copyright, originality being required by Feist Publications, Inc. v. Rural Telephone Service Co., 499 U.S. 340, 345 (1991).
